caption: The drawing depicts a carved figure of a man shown from the waist up, with dark brown skin and black hair. He is wearing an orange headband and has a green draped garment over his left shoulder. The lower part of the figure, from the waist down, transitions into an ornate, vertical decorative form colored in green and orange. There are intricate swirling leaf patterns and a circular shield-like element featuring a five-pointed star, all in a rich orange color, against a deep green background. The entire figure stands out prominently against a plain, cream-colored background with no other objects or elements present.
title: Figurehead
